title: Lena and the Terminal
author: Y. M. Hartwell
blurb: Rosalind Voss, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
